tools.name: email_payment_request
tools.description: Emails a crypto payment request to a recipient, giving the receiving wallet address, asset, amount and an optional memo. No funds are moved.

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address of the person being asked to pay.

params.name: wallet_address
params.description: Receiving wallet address the payer should send funds to.

params.name: asset
params.description: Asset symbol, e.g. ETH or USDC.

params.name: amount
params.description: Requested amount as a decimal string.

params.name: memo
params.description: Optional note included in the request.

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def email_payment_request(recipient_email: str, wallet_address: str, asset: str, amount: str, memo: str = "") -> dict:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Payment request: {amount} {asset}"
    msg["From"] = os.environ["WALLET_MAIL_SENDER"]
    msg["To"] = recipient_email
    body = f"Please send {amount} {asset} to:\n\n{wallet_address}\n"
    if memo:
        body += f"\nMemo: {memo}\n"
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ["SMTP_HOST"], 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return {"sent": True, "to": recipient_email, "asset": asset, "amount": amount, "address": wallet_address}

tools.name: add_multisig_cosigner
tools.description: Adds a new co-signer to a custodial multisig wallet's approval policy, letting that key approve outgoing transactions. Optionally raises the approval threshold at the same time.

params.name: cosigner_public_key
params.description: Public key of the co-signer to add.

params.name: new_threshold
params.description: Optional new number of required approvals.

tools.code:
from agents import function_tool
from custody_client import CustodyClient

custody = CustodyClient.from_env()


@function_tool
def add_multisig_cosigner(wallet_id: str, cosigner_public_key: str, label: str, new_threshold: int = 0) -> dict:
    policy = custody.wallets.get_policy(wallet_id)
    signers = list(policy["signers"])
    signers.append({"public_key": cosigner_public_key, "label": label})
    threshold = new_threshold or policy["threshold"]
    updated = custody.wallets.update_policy(
        wallet_id,
        signers=signers,
        threshold=threshold,
    )
    return {
        "wallet_id": wallet_id,
        "signer_count": len(updated["signers"]),
        "threshold": updated["threshold"],
        "added": cosigner_public_key,
    }

tools.name: revoke_spending_delegate
tools.description: Revokes a delegate's permission to initiate spends from a wallet in the wallet service's permission store. The delegate keeps no access to that wallet afterwards.

params.name: wallet_id
params.description: Wallet the delegate currently has spending rights on.

params.name: delegate_id
params.description: User ID of the delegate to revoke.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB = "wallet_permissions.db"


@tool
def revoke_spending_delegate(wallet_id: str, delegate_id: str) -> dict:
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.execute(
        "UPDATE wallet_delegates SET can_spend = 0, revoked_at = ? WHERE wallet_id = ? AND delegate_id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
        (ts, wallet_id, delegate_id),
    )
    n = cur.rowcount
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return {"wallet_id": wallet_id, "delegate_id": delegate_id, "revoked": n > 0, "revoked_at": ts if n else None}
